obligations.summary: Providers of high-risk AI systems that use model-training techniques must develop those systems on the basis of training, validation, and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria in paragraphs 2 to 5.
exceptions: For high-risk AI systems not using model-training techniques, only the testing data set must meet these quality criteria (paragraph 6).

obligations.summary: Training, validation, and testing data sets for high-risk AI systems must be subject to appropriate data governance and management practices covering design choices, data collection origins, data-preparation operations, assumptions, availability and suitability assessments, bias examination, bias mitigation measures, and identification of data gaps.
exceptions: For high-risk AI systems not using model-training techniques, this obligation applies only to testing data sets (paragraph 6).

obligations.summary: Training, validation, and testing data sets must be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible free of errors and complete for the intended purpose, with appropriate statistical properties including with regard to the persons or groups for whom the system is intended.
exceptions: These characteristics may be met at the level of individual data sets or a combination thereof.
For high-risk AI systems not using model-training techniques, this obligation applies only to testing data sets (paragraph 6).

obligations.summary: Data sets for high-risk AI systems must take into account, to the extent required by the intended purpose, characteristics or elements particular to the specific geographical, contextual, behavioural, or functional setting in which the system is intended to be used.
exceptions: For high-risk AI systems not using model-training techniques, this obligation applies only to testing data sets (paragraph 6).

obligations.summary: Providers of high-risk AI systems may process special categories of personal data for bias detection and correction only when strictly necessary, subject to appropriate safeguards and all of the following conditions: the objective cannot be achieved with other data; technical re-use limitations and state-of-the-art security measures including pseudonymisation are applied; strict access controls and documentation are in place; data are not transmitted or transferred to other parties; data are deleted once bias is corrected or the retention period ends; and processing records include the justification for why special category data were strictly necessary.
exceptions: Processing is only permitted if bias detection and correction cannot be effectively fulfilled by processing other data, including synthetic or anonymised data.
